# LiteraryWorm - Ebooks and Audiobooks Subscription Service

> LiteraryWorm provides an innovative platform for reading ebooks and listening to audiobooks, ideal for families with customizable profiles. With flexible pricing plans, users can enjoy access to a broad library while managing their subscriptions easily.

LiteraryWorm is a go-to option for avid readers and listeners, featuring plans that cater to individuals and families alike. The service is designed to enhance the reading and listening experience with a user-friendly interface and diverse content.

## Main Features

- **Ebook and Audiobook Access**: Subscribers can access a wide variety of ebooks and audiobooks, catering to different tastes and preferences.
- **Customizable Profiles**: Each household member can have their own profile, allowing personalized recommendations and tracking.
- **Flexible Pricing Plans**: Users can choose from Basic, Standard, or Premium plans, either monthly or yearly.

## Pricing Information

- **[LiteraryWorm - Plans](https://www.literaryworm.com/plans)**: This page details the subscription options available. Prices are as follows:
  - Basic: $9.99/month or $99.90/year
  - Standard: $14.99/month or $149.90/year
  - Premium: $24.99/month or $249.90/year
